content:
alejandro: kicking off dedicated H100 canary (cohort A, 3 hosts) to driver 535.44 + CUDA 12.2 in eu-central-1. seeing repeated GPU crashes on host ec2-h100-07, nvml failing and pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff. rolling back cohort or pause?

mira: pausing rollout now. can you paste dmesg / nvidia-smi output? also flagging: some hosts still on 5.15 kernel, others on 6.1 — might be a mismatch. :eyes:

samir: raw dmesg snippet from ec2-h100-07:
```
[  123.456789] nvidia: module license 'NVIDIA' taints kernel.
[  123.457000] nvcuda: probe of 0000:3d:00.0 failed with error -22
[  123.457200] nv-hostengine: kernel oops, stack trace: ...
[  123.457500] nvidia-modeset: failed to register char device
```
and nvidia-smi returns: `NVML: Driver/library version mismatch` then `Failed to initialize NVML: Unknown Error`.

samir: looks like the driver packages were built against a different kernel ABI or outdated dkms hooks didn't run on some hosts. suggestion: rollback driver to 525.105.05 which was stable across current kernel pool, run `dkms status` and restart host-agent.

eng-deploy-bot: rollout paused by mira (reason: canary failure). cohort A suspended.

jess: how many dedicated customers could be impacted? status from capacity dashboard: 2/60 H100 hosts in eu-central flagged degraded; Dedicated customers on those hosts: cust-omega (private pool) and internal perf-suite. minimal customer-facing impact so far but CS should be notified.

patrick-sre: checked NIC/firmware on ec2-h100-07 — mlx5 driver is 5.8.x while image expects 5.11 for the new kernel. mlx5 firmware mismatch can cause udev/NIC timeouts which amplify GPU driver instability. recommend we either pin kernel+mlx drivers or skip kernel upgrade in the same rollout.

alejandro: ack. action plan so far:
- rollback driver on the 3 cohort hosts to 525.105.05 (samir)
- run `gpu-health --full --nvml --ncc` across all H100 nodes (alejandro)
- add kernel/device-driver compatibility check to canary gating (mira)
- notify CS and affected customers (jess)
- create incident ticket and timeline (alejandro -> INC-2458)

samir: rollback commands I ran on ec2-h100-07:
```
sudo apt remove --purge nvidia-driver-535
sudo apt install nvidia-driver-525=525.105.05-0
sudo dkms autoinstall
sudo systemctl restart host-agent
```
after that `nvidia-smi` shows GPUs online again. single-node smoke tests passed (cuda samples + small nccl allreduce).

mira: please update canary config: exclude hosts with kernel <--> mlx mismatch and reduce cohort size to 2 next attempt. also add a preflight that verifies `dkms status` shows built modules for the running kernel.

alejandro: updating canary YAML now, will run preflight script: `/usr/local/bin/inference-canary-preflight --check-dkms --check-nic-fw --check-nvlib` before next rollout.

jess: opened CS ticket with cust-omega, sent the mitigation notes and ETA ~2 hours.

patrick-sre: long term we should publish a matrix of supported kernel/driver/mlnx combinations for Dedicated images and gate upgrades on that matrix. also consider shipping driver as part of host image instead of live package for these fleets.

alejandro: agreed. follow-ups: INC-2458 (tracking), patch to canary gating (mira), host-image proposal (patrick-sre). rolling back cohort completed at 1759984600, monitoring.

eng-deploy-bot: cohort A rollback completed by samir at 1759984600.

alejandro: monitoring looks stable — NVML healthy on previously-failed host. will re-run extended NCCL allreduce + perf suite overnight before rescheduling upgrade. thanks all. :thumbsup:
